steps.title: Grumpy Tom
steps.body: A minifig has a resting face and a face for each mood: Happy, Angry, Sad, Scared and Surprised. A dialogue line has a mood, and in Play its speaker shows that face, on the figure and in the dialogue box's portrait. You make Tom, a gate keeper, and give him his faces.
steps.task: Make Tom, a neighbour on the map.

how.text: Make a character called Tom and put him on the map beside where the player starts (Brix's helper does both).

do.say: Tom, a neighbour on the map.

steps.title: The Face tab
steps.body: The Face tab shows a picture of each mood's face, and the preview looks at the head. Resting is the face he has when nothing is said; it is the same as the face in the Look tab.
steps.task: In the character sheet, click the tab “Face”.

how.text: In the character sheet on the right, click the tab “Face”. Six pictures show his faces.

steps.title: His angry face
steps.body: Each mood starts from a sensible face (Angry frowns, Scared opens the eyes wide). Change the parts that make it his: the expression and the eyes. Everything else stays his resting face.
steps.task: Pick Angry and give it Wide eyes.

how.text: Under “Face”, click the picture “Angry”. The preview shows his angry face.
Under “Angry face”, click the button beside “Eyes”, then click “Wide”.

steps.title: His happy face
steps.body: Happy grins by default. Tom laughs when he is happy.
steps.task: Pick Happy and give it the expression Laughing.

how.text: Click the button beside “Expression”, then click “Laughing”.

steps.title: Lines with moods
steps.body: In a conversation's script a mood goes in brackets after the speaker: “Tom (angry): Who left the gate open?”. The list view shows it as the line's mood.
steps.task: Give Tom a conversation: an angry line, then a happy one.

args.script:
== start
Tom (angry): Who left the gate open?
Tom (happy): Oh, it was you closing it! Thank you!
-> end

how.text: Brix's helper makes Tom a conversation and opens it in the Dialogue view.
In the Script view, write: == start, then Tom (angry): Who left the gate open?, then Tom (happy): Oh, it was you closing it! Thank you!, then -> end.

args.script:
== start
Tom (angry): Who left the gate open?
Tom (happy): Oh, it was you closing it! Thank you!
-> end

do.say: An angry line, then a happy one.

steps.title: Talk to Tom
steps.body: In Play, Tom glares with wide eyes while he says his angry line, and his portrait in the box shows the same face; then he laughs.
steps.task: Play this map and talk to Tom (walk up to him and press T).

steps.title: A character from a picture
steps.body: Stop with F5. A photo, a drawing or a few words become three characters to pick from, made only of editor settings, so everything stays editable. With the AI builder set up Claude looks at the picture; without it the editor reads the words and takes the picture's main colours.
steps.task: On the Characters screen, press ✨ From a picture….

how.text: Stop Play (F5), open the Characters screen, and under + New character press “✨ From a picture…”.

steps.title: Describe it
steps.body: Drop a picture in the box, or describe the character. Create shows three matches, closest first, with what each part matched.
steps.task: In “Or describe it”, type a green owl with orange wings and press Create.

doItForMe.value: a green owl with orange wings

how.text: Click the box “Or describe it” and type: a green owl with orange wings.

do.value: a green owl with orange wings
do.say: A green owl with orange wings

how.text: Press “Create”. Three owls show on the right.

steps.title: Pick one
steps.body: The match you pick becomes a character of the game, opened in the studio: change anything you like. Undo takes it away again.
steps.task: Press Use this one on the closest match.

how.text: On the first match (“Closest · Green Owl”), press “Use this one”. The owl opens in the Body tab.

steps.title: You can make faces and characters from pictures
steps.body: The Face tab has the resting face and one for each mood; lines with a mood show it in Play. ✨ From a picture is also in the Assets menu. Help › Help guide › Characters has every part.
